label: baseline-1
methodology: Same canister binary, fresh canister per operation/size/trial. Implementations alternate by trial. Configuration is outside measured scope, clears both queues; four forced GC increments precede each measurement. Raw performanceCounter(0) and allocation deltas include dispatch/loop/checksum overhead; no reply or end-message GC. Live memory is measured separately by memory probe. Counts match and complete post-operation array values are checked against a JS model. Payloads are compact Nat values.
